whenToUse: Spreadsheet-style bulk editing of product prices and stock with live margin.
Batch adjustments by percentage with review before publishing to all channels.
avoidWhen: Editing one product in depth — use detail-07.
a11y: A role="grid" with gridcells, arrow-key navigation, aria-selected and aria-invalid on bad values.
Below-cost warnings use role="alert"; read-only cells set aria-readonly.
